name: 德业股份
period_definition: Seven original holding years, plus three finite physical-capital transition years for primary only; normalized retains seven years. No company rerun authorized at this static stage.

base.rights_convention: Assume existing and remaining planned treasury shares are granted before the first modeled dividend: gross issued rights restored, no permanent cancellation/no extra share issuance. Planned total employee remuneration100m is expensed over3 years, added back as noncash and replaced by actual past/future purchase cash once. All other prospective remuneration in cash opex; no forecast perpetual SBC addback.
base.anchor_rule: q3.revenue_9m + q3.revenue_quarter; Q4 flat Q3 normalization, not reported FY26 or observed Q3 product split

battery_policy.tax_basis_rule: New affected FOB revenue; solve price increase circular tax base using 1/(1-pass*loss). Year1=10/12 of6 points because holding year spans Nov-Dec2026 and Jan-Oct2027. Uniform export seasonality is assumption. No extra3-point April2026 deduction. Malaysia tax benefit not precredited.

working_capital.note: Supplier-credit purchases = 86% of production cash COGS excluding incremental rebate loss + production-cost inventory change + writeoff; max zero. Reference DA is based on realized pre-policy-price revenue Xadj, not repriced revenue. Inventory excludes incremental export rebate loss too, so no indirect tax-loss AP through inventory. The rebate loss remains paid in same-period operating cash via NOPAT, with no modeled refund receivable or tax payment deferral. 86% is FY25 calibration, not exact26 mix. Purchase VAT applies only to actual production purchases. Opening capital AP settled through project cash.

opening_estimates.minority_bridge_rule: Actual group excess cash E=F-B-C, with no minority deduction. NCI Q3 book equity is a constant value-allocation proxy deducted once in each current/future common-equity bridge, not restricted cash or a cash liability. No separate minority profit/distribution state is forecast; possible future changes are a limited-size attribution uncertainty, not a legal payout fact.
opening_estimates.note: Not reported Oct31 balances. Q3 assets plus separately disclosed Oct payments plus explicit estimated one-month cash bridge. Net currency/derivative mark beyond recorded liability assumed0; financial composition sensitivity covers +/-400m. Cash-equivalent gap and additional deposits modeled required rather than free. October CFO implied by NOPAT+DA-dWC; no cumulative9M CFO annualization.

Capacity3GW*0.30yuan/W and200ksets*10kWh*700yuan/kWh are feasibility assumptions, not achieved ASP/orders.

base.depreciation_scope_note: The known PhaseI land94.078m is already in current assets outside CIP and also inside full project budget: remove from general productive pool before adding commissioned project capital, so it is not depreciated twice.8% is a blended forecast capital-consumption/maintenance approximation, not a claim of land statutory useful life or company detailed depreciation policy.
base.lease_convention: Capitalized lease method: ROU excluded from general8% depreciation base, H126 ROU amortization annualized separately. Existing lease liability included once in opening debt/current maturities. Future replacement rights paid in cash within maintenance capex, no new lease borrowing and no second cash-rent expense. Lease asset balance retained by equal replacement investment.
base.capacity_proxy_rule: Forward demand capped by uncertain annual sales-capacity at2026 prices; price indices adjust capacity, organic capex adds capacity next year. Existing capacity proxies calibrated to annualized run-rate and FY25 utilization, not observed2026 installed nameplate. Output both demand, cap, lost sales; sensitivity +/-15% required. Committed capital still spent if cap binds.

parent.share_plan_allocation_note: Working allocation: listed issuer bears known-plan noncash service expense without subsidiary recharge. Not proven employee-entity allocation and not necessarily conservative. Explicit0%/100% scenarios recompute subsidiary profit, upstream, parentRE and actual dividend. Buyback principal and direct transaction fees change issuer cash/equity, not ordinary profit/RE. Group expense and cash counted once. Future transaction fees budget0, not proven free execution.
parent.liquidity_classification_rule: Mother total M is preserved. Locate minimum buffer first inside existing group operating cash B; remaining M in actual group excess E, then unused B and support C. Only mother financial bucket earns modeled yield and funds ordinary distribution, less minimum residual not already in B. No transfer, RE expense, principal loss or extra group cash. Amount outside E+B+C is a conditional entity-bridge estimate conflict, not automatic group financing null.
parent.note: Explicit unknown H2-toOct bridge from actual H1 mother balances, not fabricated Q3 mother statements.80% upstream leaves20% of subsidiaries' current profit, sufficient for a full10% annual statutory allocation without relying on liquidation of old subsidiary reserves. Collection limited by group surplus outside mother, no intercompany inflow counted twice.

terminal.note: PRIMARY:7 original years +3 finite physical-capital transition years; mature cash has funded growth/replacement and an exact growing+constant continuation. No NOPAT*g/20% proof. NORMALIZED:7-year normalization then its separately declared mature return. Financial bridge/NCI same-date; no automatic principal discount. Waiting all-short and budget-proxy two-bucket hypotheses are explicitly noncore, not law/commitments.
terminal.incremental_operating_return_note: Primary base uses independently budgeted physical capital/cash continuation, no default20% return. Normalized mature return resides only in auxiliary.incremental_operating_return. Scenario terminal_return changes only the mature mechanism; aux_explicit_return alone changes explicit normalized investment.
terminal.waiting_partition_note: Main noncore diagnostic puts all E at surplus lag and all strategic A at strategic lag. Additional budget-proxy split: positive motherRE+positive subsidiary reserves is only an assumed short-wait budget capacity, cash allocated first then A; residual waits long_lag. NOT a finding of legal restriction or actual liquidation dates. Debt and NCI value deduction once at horizon.

auxiliary.demand_timing_rule: Year t=1..N demand=anchor*segment_weight*anchor_utilization_factor*(1+g_aux)^t*demand_level_t; g_aux uses scenario terminal_growth if supplied else auxiliary.growth. No primary volume_growth_multiplier, volume/ASP curve or capacity_multiplier in auxiliary demand.
auxiliary.extra_capital_depreciation_rule: Sequential, not implicit: current DA includes cumulative prior auxiliary extra only; current extra enters fixed book at period end and begins full depreciation next year. No half-year current extra DA. Maintenance replaces DA, not added again to growth-capital pool.
auxiliary.note: Independent normalized current-cycle earnings at90% scale, not main year7 earnings or marketPE. Explicit g/aux_explicit_return budget (default20%) subject to signed project cash floor. terminal_return is mature only; future extra starts DA next year. Same cash/debt/parent bridge; no averaging.
auxiliary.return_scope_note: aux_explicit_return defaults20% and alone funds explicit normalized investment; scenario aux_explicit_return may explicitly override. terminal_return never dispatches into explicit years.

maturity_transition.capital_cost_basis: Independent physical capacity-cost work assumption: Malaysia capacity proxy900+1400m annual2026-price sales / full149.98mUSD*7.0 scope1049.86m gives approximately2.2x. Uses full-program scope rather than only lowest domestic fixed investment; future replication cost, not observed realized ROIC. No value or20% target used to set it.
maturity_transition.volume_growth_fade: Linear from each segment last explicit volume growth to scenario terminal_growth or base terminal.growth over3 years. Start from actual capacity-limited pre-policy sales, no catch-up of unserved demand.
maturity_transition.asp_change_fade: Linearly fade last explicit ASP change to zero over3 years. Reference margins and export/tax exposure hold last explicit assumptions; no margin recovery.
maturity_transition.investment_rule: Each new year funds next-year incremental physical sales volume at maximum utilization and2.2x capacity/capital. No zero-cost credit for repurposing idle old lines for new product/geographic incremental sales. New capacity/capital available next year; no current half-year depreciation on end-year transition additions. Legacy segment also must fund incremental capacity.
maturity_transition.terminal_budget_mode: Exact operating cash continuation with fixed-asset/DA stock continuity; base physical unit-cost budget implies long-run incremental return, not a hardcoded20% proof. A terminal_return scenario is an explicit mature capital-efficiency conditional override only.
maturity_transition.proxy_range_note: Conditional envelope only:2.6 roughly fixed Malaysia scope ratio;2.2 full-program ratio;1.8 adds about20% program overrun/replication cost. Not universal observed efficiency; existing terminal-return conditions expose implied productivity and report out-of-envelope, no new full scenarios.
maturity_transition.maintenance_cost_scope_note: Legacy installed capacity keeps its location-specific modeled replacement allowance (8% productive book plus separate ROU cash renewal). Growth2.2x references more capital-intensive new replication; it is not retroactive revaluation of all cheap existing domestic lines. No perpetual free legacy asset: replacement cash is paid every year. Flat nominal per-unit legacy replacement costs are an explicit technology/procurement-offset assumption, not evidence that future capital prices cannot rise.

terminal_value_bounds.scope: Base period1-7 operating and actual distribution budgets retained; future operating discount and post-year7 mature reinvestment change. Year3/year5 independently value remaining operating FCFF/terminal plus their own post-distribution financial assets/net debt. No copied/interpolated current value, no default operating-rate discount of financial principal, no artificial horizon liquidation in core.

research_limits: No observed Q3 segment margin/export split. Forward segment weights/growth/margins explicit estimates calibrated against FY25 and H126, not mislabeled actual.
0/50/100% rebate pass-through lacks company contract/quote proof; central50% a work case, no assigned probability; model recomputes price/volume/cost and distributions.
Existing capacity, project cumulative payments/remaining fixed scope, Oct financial bridge and mother H2 bridge are bounded estimates. Sensitivities are mandatory, not hidden exactness.
All trading-financial-liability marked amount deducted at opening; related cash/derivative results not also included in operating gross margins. No denied FCC document retried.
No new H-share financing assumed. Existing ordinary shares, treasury grants and options paired with real/budgeted cash. No current market quote, target multiple or IRR input.
